# Shaheen Funding

> Shaheen Funding LLC is an independent, licensed advisory firm for UAE business finance: we take your file to 10+ UAE banks and financiers and you choose between the offers.

- Licensed in Sharjah Media City Free Zone, Trade Licence No. 2649746.01.
- We take the file straight to the heads of business banking and SME lending at 10+ UAE banks and financiers.
- Offers within 4 to 7 days. Funds in 2 to 4 weeks after you sign.
- No upfront fees. Success fee only after the funds reach the client's account.
- Offers usually under 1% a month (general funding and invoice discounting). POS funding from under 0.6% a month.
- Four documents: trade licence, last 12 months of bank statements, VAT returns for the last 4 quarters, Memorandum of Association (MOA). A mutual NDA is signed first.
- For established UAE companies with a timing problem: a healthy business with a cashflow gap.

## Funding pages

- [Business loan in UAE](https://shaheenfunding.com/business-loan-uae/): Interest rate, requirements, how to apply and how we match your file to 10+ lenders.
- [SME loan in UAE](https://shaheenfunding.com/sme-loan-uae/): What an SME loan is, SME financing in Dubai and which facility fits your business.
- [Invoice discounting in UAE](https://shaheenfunding.com/invoice-discounting-uae/): A limit approved once and held at the bank, drawn against invoices for 3 to 4 years.
- [POS loan in Dubai](https://shaheenfunding.com/pos-loan-dubai/): Funding sized on POS sales for restaurants, cafes and retail, from under 0.6% a month.
- [Working capital loan in Dubai](https://shaheenfunding.com/working-capital-loan-dubai/): How a working capital loan works and how to get one.
- [Business loan broker in Dubai](https://shaheenfunding.com/business-loan-broker-dubai/): What a business loan broker does, and what it costs: no upfront fees, success fee only after funds land.
- [Documents required for a business loan in UAE](https://shaheenfunding.com/documents-required-for-business-loan-uae/): The four documents, the mutual NDA and the 4-step timeline from call to funds.
- [Equipment finance in UAE](https://shaheenfunding.com/equipment-finance-uae/): Funding for raw materials, stock and equipment for manufacturing companies.
